= attribute-text-pass(1)
:doctype: manpage
:manmanual: Attribute tests
:mansource: acdc
:revdate: 2026-10-01
:name: Early
:ordinary: <ordinary> &
:raw: pass:[<raw> &]
:a: pass:a[{name} *Bold*]
:c: pass:c[<x> & {name} *Bold*]
:ac: pass:a,c[{raw}]
:ca: pass:c,a[{raw}]
:long: pass:specialcharacters,attributes[{name} <x> &]
:none: pass:none[{name} &]
:escaped: pass:a[\{name} {name\} \{name\} \\{name}]
:nested: pass:a[pass:[{name}]]
:empty: pass:a[]
:missing: pass:a[{not-set}]
:brackets: pass:a[{name} a\]b]
:alias: prefix {c} / {a}
:normal-a: pass:a[{ordinary}]
:normal-ac: pass:a,c[{ordinary}]
:normal-ca: pass:c,a[{ordinary}]
:duplicate: pass:c,a,c[{raw}]
:verbatim: pass:v[<x> & {name}]
:long-verbatim: pass:verbatim[<x> & {name}]
:entities: pass:c[&#169; &amp;]
:unicode: pass:c[café <α> &]
:character: pass:a[{lt}{gt}{amp}]
:none-c: pass:none,c[<&>]
:nested-c: pass:a[pass:c[{name}]]

== Name
attribute-text-pass - text-only attribute substitutions
